item_name: Rothco Womens Thin Red Line Longer T-Shirt
item_short_desc: Show your support for your local firefighters with Rothco Women's Thin Red Line Longer T-Shirt!
description: Rothco’s Women’s Thin Red Line Longer T-Shirt is made from a soft cotton/poly blend. The longer length style of this shirt extends past the waist and features a tagless label for extra comfort. A vertical distressed thin red line flag imprint is centered on the front chest of the t-shirt, as a symbol of respect and support for Firefighters.
